item.title: [Press Release] Cregis Marks Two Years of Middle East Growth as Traditional Financial Firms Drive Adoption
item.description: Enterprise digital asset infrastructure platform Cregis marks two years of growth across the UAE and Middle East serving institutional trading and financial firms.

item.title: Dogecoin Slides 8%, Bitcoin Drops Under $84,000 as Treasury Yields Hit 2007 Highs
item.description: Dogecoin fell 8% and Bitcoin slid under $84,000 as surging US Treasury yields and $104 crude oil ignited a broad crypto market selloff.

item.title: USD/JPY Outlook: Hawkish Federal Reserve Recalibration Mounts Pressure on the Japanese Yen
item.description: USD/JPY pushed higher toward key resistance zones as resilient US growth data and surging Treasury yields widened the US-Japan interest rate divergence.

item.title: Trump Administration Weighs Global Stablecoin Framework to Cement US Dollar Dominance
item.description: High-level discussions examine integrating dollar-pegged digital assets into foreign economic policy to expand treasury absorption and counter rival currency blocs.

item.title: [Press Release] LBank Ranks No. 1 for Mainstream Crypto ($52.16M) and Stock Depth (4.4x) in BeInCrypto Report
item.description: A comprehensive market depth study published by BeInCrypto evaluates order-book liquidity, ranking LBank first among top tier cryptocurrency exchanges.

item.title: [Press Release] BC.GAME’s BC Engine Rewards Surpass $8.6 Million as Ecosystem Growth Accelerates
item.description: Cumulative rewards distributed through the BC Engine protocol surge past $8.6 million as user participation and network utility expand fourfold.
